description: Divide one booking code into 2 to 20 smaller codes on the same bookmaker so every game lands in exactly one new code. Supports 4 split methods: 'equal' (spread games evenly across codes), 'by_batches' (keep consecutive games together in each code), 'target_odds' (group games to reach a chosen combined odds per code), and 'custom' (set exact game counts per output code). Supports 2 game orders: 'mixed' (keep original slip order) and 'by_start_time' (earliest games first, latest games last). Costs 2 credits plus 1 credit per extra created code; unused parts are refunded.

count.description: Number of output codes (2 to 20) when method is 'equal' or 'by_batches'.

counts.description: Exact game count for each output code (must sum to total games on the slip) when method is 'custom'.

order.description: Game order: 'mixed' (original slip order) or 'by_start_time' (sorted by kickoff).

target_odds.description: Target combined odds per output code (e.g. 5.0) when method is 'target_odds'.

name: mbc_split_code
title: Split Bet Code Into 2–20 Codes
